has_own_site_note: The only public link on the Google Business listing is mesubbim.square.site, a Square (square.site) booking/ecommerce subdomain. Per pipeline rule this does NOT count as an own website, so angle is 'we built you a free demo website'.

No public business email found anywhere. Only non-business email found was an internal Sentry.io error-tracking address, excluded as irrelevant.
hours_source: getsauce.com/order/site/mesubbim-express (3rd-party ordering site for the same business, same address). Google Maps overview only showed 'Open . Closes 6PM' for the snapshot day without full weekly hours.
kosher_certification: ORB (Orthodox Rabbinical Board of South Florida). Savory bakery (MALOHACH) items are Pas Yisroel.
brand_description: Mesubbim is a kosher bakery, prepared-foods counter and catering kitchen at 7160 Beracasa Way in Boca Raton's Del Mar Village plaza. The storefront sells two linked menus: a sweet bakery (MATOK) and savory bakery / prepared Israeli foods (MALOHACH, Pas Yisroel) for pickup, delivery and Shabbat/holiday catering, plus a kosher sandwich counter (branded Mesubbim Express at the same address) serving schnitzel sandwiches, wraps and bowls for lunch. ORB certified.
brand_vibe: Warm cream background, thin gold rule, small deep-red/wine dot accents, black serif wordmark 'MESUBBIM' with a steaming bowl icon and the line 'A Traditional Kosher Experience'. Light, warm, quiet-luxury deli/bakery look.
current_notice: Square site currently shows a banner: 'We're moving and expanding! Limited menu this week.' Not used verbatim as a site headline (time-sensitive operational note, not brand copy), but confirms the business is active and growing.

reviews.author: Sivan Ravit
reviews.text: Love ordering from Mesubbim! Great food, amazing service, and perfect portions every time. My guests are always happy and keep asking where it's from. Everything is fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. It truly tastes like home-cooked food, made with care and attention to detail. Makes hosting so much easier and more enjoyable, highly recommend!

reviews.author: R C
reviews.meta: Local Guide, 25 reviews, 7 photos, 10 months ago
reviews.text: Tastes amazing and they use olive oil in the pargit. Not seed oil. Also they use real fresh lemon juice in the tahini. Very good service too.

reviews.author: OHANA Locksmith & Security
reviews.text: I'll start by saying they deserve 10 stars. From the moment I call to get information to the end of my son Aliyah LaTorah, they helped to make your event a success. I love how they listen and help, how they made it easier specially with all the stress involved with an event. The food was amazing, and you get soooooo much for what you pay. Great service. Thank you again the Ohana family.

reviews.author: E Joy B
reviews.meta: Local Guide, 21 reviews, 4 photos, 2 years ago
reviews.text: Messubbims food is absolutely delicious!! The flavors were rich, and the freshness of the ingredients stood out. From savory hummus to succulent grilled meats, pargiot, grilled chicken breast, each dish was a celebration of Mediterranean cuisine. The perfect choice for a festive Shabbat gathering and beyond.
